subject: MAP: Security & compliance intake for Capitol Bank POC
messages:
From: Sam Torres <s.torres@capitolbank.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Capitol Bank Legal <contracts@capitolbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T08:12:00Z
Subject: MAP intake - security & compliance for POC

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. We'd like to move the POC forward but need a concrete Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the security/compliance gates and owners for acceptance. To speed the internal review, can you: 

- Share a proposed MAP with milestones for SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ answers, DPA finalization, and data retention commitments
- Identify Redwood evidence owners and a realistic timeline to close the gates (we're targeting POC start 2027-01-10)
- Attach any initial artifacts (SOC 2 coverage summary, example SIG answers)

Our legal team is copied and will attach redlines if needed. Key constraints: data must remain in US regions for this POC and retention windows for transactional logs need to be explicit.

Best,
Sam
Sam Torres
Head of Platform Security, Capitol Bank

---
Attachment: (none)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@capitolbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T12:04:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP intake - security & compliance for POC

Sam — thanks for the clarity. Taking the ask, attached is a first-pass MAP/MPA outline (MPA-outline.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 coverage summary (SOC2-coverage.pdf). Highlights up front: 

- Proposed milestone cadence (high level):
  * Week 0 (2027-01-10): POC kickoff (env setup)
  * Week 1-2: SIG/CAIQ answers + evidence collection (owner: Irene Choi)
  * Week 3: SOC 2 scoping & targeted evidence review (owner: Marissa Cole)
  * Week 4: DPA negotiation & sign (owner: Neha Kapoor)
  * Week 5: Final acceptance checklist + smoke tests

- Data residency: we'll provision US-only tenancy for POC and document storage endpoints.
- Data retention (proposal): transactional logs 3 years (retained for audit), backups 7 years (encrypted at rest), ephemeral request cache 90 days. If Capitol Bank needs alternate windows we can update the MAP.

I'll loop in Irene and Neha to validate the SIG checklist and DPA timeline. I've attached the artifacts referenced.

Next step: can Capitol confirm evidence owners on your side and the target SLA for review cycles (e.g., 3 business days per review)?

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: MPA-outline.xlsx, SOC2-coverage.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@capitolbank.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T09:18:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP intake - security & compliance for POC

Sam — looping in the security lead (Jonas) and calling out owners for SIG and evidence intake. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) SIG/CAIQ: we'll deliver a completed SIG-CAIQ-answers.xlsx within the Week 1-2 window. That will include references to our SOC 2 artifacts and where we have compensating controls. Expect the SIG to come with linked evidence pointers (drive urls).

2) SOC 2: the attached SOC2-coverage.pdf maps controls we cover for hosted inference. If Capitol needs auditor-level evidence (full SOC 2 report), please confirm and we'll escalate timing for access.

3) Data retention specifics: Redwood proposes the following default policy for POC-only tenancy: transactional logs (3 years), backups (7 years, encrypted), and aggregated telemetry for quality monitoring (12 months). For sandbox POC we can reduce to shorter windows but will need an explicit request for permanent changes.

4) Evidence owners: Redwood side: SIG/Evidence intake — Irene Choi; SOC 2 coordination — Marissa Cole; DPA/legal — Neha Kapoor; Runtime configuration & residency — Jonas Weber.

5) Review SLA: 3 business days per artifact is reasonable. Please confirm Capitol's target so we can lock the MAP dates.

Cheers,
Irene Choi | Security PM | Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-answers.xlsx
From: Sam Torres <s.torres@capitolbank.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Capitol Bank Legal <contracts@capitolbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-24T16:52:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP intake - security & compliance for POC

Irene / Dylan — thanks, that is helpful. A few Capitol points to confirm: 

- We confirm 3 business days per artifact review.
- Data residency requirement: US-only for POC; production consideration later.
- Data retention: transactional logs 5 years (we need to retain for certain audit scenarios). Is that acceptable?
- SOC 2: we will need the full SOC 2 Type II report for the current period during procurement prior to production go-live; for POC, the coverage summary is fine.

I've asked Legal to attach a DPA redline — they will push the DPA-redline.docx to Dylan and Neha.

Evidence owners on our side: Sam Torres (platform security), Priya Shah (security operations), Miguel Fernandes (legal technical). Expect a 2-business-day turnaround from our reviewers.

Thanks,
Sam

Attachment: (none)
From: Capitol Bank Legal <contracts@capitolbank.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <s.torres@capitolbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T14:33:00Z
Subject: DPA redline for POC

Neha / Dylan — attached is our initial DPA redline. Key asks: 

- Data deletion notice: 30 days after termination for PII (with certification of deletion)
- Subprocessor list and 30-day notice for additions
- Incident notification: 24 hours for material incidents
- Audit rights: right to request evidence of SOC 2 reports annually

We are open to negotiation on retention windows for backups, but need explicit runbook language for deletion and escrow if requested.

Please confirm receipt and an expected date for our counterparty response.

Regards,
Capitol Bank Legal

---
Attachment: DPA-redline.docx
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
To: Sam Torres <s.torres@capitolbank.com>, Capitol Bank Legal <contracts@capitolbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T16:45:00Z
Subject: MAP final: sprint closure asks, owners, and next steps

Team — summarizing the agreed MAP and next steps so we have a single source of truth before the POC kickoff. Please review and flag issues by EOD 2026-11-30.

MAP (final, POC-specific):
- POC kickoff: 2027-01-10 (provision US-only tenancy)
- Week 1 (2027-01-10 to 2027-01-16): SIG/CAIQ answers deliverable (Irene). Capitol review SLA: 3 business days.
- Week 2: Evidence collection for scoped SOC 2 controls (Marissa). POC uses SOC 2 coverage summary; full SOC 2 Type II report to be provided prior to production go-live.
- Week 3: DPA negotiation + sign (Neha). Redwood action: produce deletion certification runbook and subprocessor list. Capitol asks: 30-day notice for subprocessor additions and 24-hour incident notification — Redwood will propose compromise language in the DPA response.
- Acceptance criteria: all security gates marked green in the MPA-outline.xlsx and successful smoke tests on US tenancy services (functional + security checks).

Evidence & artifacts (attached): SIG-CAIQ-answers.xlsx, SOC2-coverage.pdf, MPA-outline.xlsx. Capitol redline received: DPA-redline.docx and under review by Neha.

Owners recap: Redwood — Irene (SIG/evidence), Marissa (SOC 2), Neha (DPA/legal), Jonas (runtime/residency). Capitol — Sam (platform security), Priya Shah (sec ops), Miguel Fernandes (legal technical).

Timelines & SLAs: artifact review 3 business days from receipt; Redwood will aim to incorporate Capitol's DPA redline comments and return a proposed compromise within 5 business days after clarification call.

Open items for the clarification call (propose 2026-12-02 @ 15:00 ET):
- Finalize retention windows (Redwood proposed: logs 3y -> Capitol requested 5y)
- Agree on deletion certification scope and cadence
- Confirm SOC 2 report access timeline for procurement

Please reply with confirmation of the call time or propose an alternative. Once accepted we will import dates into the MPA-outline.xlsx and update HS-9876543 in HubSpot.

Regards,
Dylan Brooks | Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---
